mentions.name: Lapyn
mentions.description: Product design platform where humans and AI agents work on the same project. It provides a platform-independent system of record for a product — capturing design, accessibility, translations, and behavior — that agents can interact with to generate code for any platform.
mentions.problem: With AI agents generating more and more code, there needs to be a place where the actual product decisions live — not just the design, but also accessibility, translations, behavior and so on.
mentions.source_excerpt:
It's a product design platform where humans and AI agents can work on the same project.

The main idea is to have a platform-independent system of record for your product that agents can interact with and use to generate code for any platform.
